Rosemead, Baldwin Park, Whittier, Alhambra, Sierra Madre, Monrovia, West Covina, Hacienda Heights
Located in the heart of El Monte, our outpatient treatment center is designed to feel familiar, fostering comfort, healing, and a sense of community.

Our holistic approach integrates therapeutic programs and experiential treatments to support your whole self. Your dedicated team works one-on-one with you to uncover and address the root causes of your challenges.
Often considered disorganized or flighty, those with ADHD and learning disorders need professional support to maintain concentration.
Often just thought of as profound sadness, depression can also look like a lack of interest in people or activities.
While everyone worries, those with anxiety find that their fears interfere with their daily activities.
When stress piles up or doesn’t let up, it can get harder to cope, leading to persistent, unrelenting tension.

At Clear Behavioral Health, we’re not just experts in treating your mental health. We’re adept at helping you navigate your insurance to facilitate treatment, accepting most major insurance and plans. Call today and let us help you through the maze.
Let us help you through the maze.
Our thoughtfully designed, in-network mental health and/or addiction programs are delivered affordably in a comfortable setting nearby, or online across California.

Our residential program provides 24/7 immersive care for individuals with severe or persistent mental health needs. With an average stay of 30 days, clients receive intensive psychiatric support, a safe and supportive environment, and structured daily programming to promote stability and healing.

Our Virtual IOP offers flexible, remote mental health care ideal for working adults, students, or those needing accessible support. Treatment typically includes virtual therapy for 3 hours a day, 3 days a week, over 8 to 12 weeks—providing structure and healing without disrupting daily life.

Our medically supervised detox program provides 24/7 care in a safe, supportive environment for people withdrawing from drugs or alcohol. With continuous monitoring and evidence-based safety protocols, we help manage withdrawal symptoms and prepare clients for the next step in recovery.

Our residential rehab program offers full-time, structured care for individuals recovering from substance use, either following detox or as a primary treatment. With an average stay of 30+ days, clients receive daily therapy, medical support, relapse prevention planning, and holistic services in a supportive environment.

Our Dual Diagnosis Program is designed for individuals navigating both mental health and substance use disorders. Through integrated, whole-person care that combines clinical therapy and psychiatric support, we help clients address the root causes of both conditions and build a path to lasting recovery.

Our Outpatient Rehab offers flexible addiction treatment for individuals who don’t require 24/7 residential care. With options like Intensive Outpatient (IOP) and Partial Hospitalization (PHP), this level of support is ideal for those transitioning from inpatient care or managing recovery alongside daily responsibilities.

The teen years are complicated for everyone and impact an entire family. If you are concerned that your teen is experiencing significant mental health or addiction issues, Clear Behavioral Health’s team of compassionate adolescent mental health experts can help.

We specialize in a range of affordable and flexible teen-focused services to meet the needs of each unique adolescent, addressing mental health challenges and unhealthy coping mechanisms by treating underlying causes and contributing factors, such as attitudes, values and family dynamics. Together, we’ll work with you to determine which services will work best for your teen.
Clear Behavioral Health has supported the wellbeing of clients throughout Southern California for over a decade.
Convenient, affordable, immediate, and easy to obtain
Expert clinical care centered around your unique & evolving goals
Deep local support from your care team and peers, today and tomorrow

Welcome to our El Monte treatment center, where compassion meets comprehensive care in a warm and welcoming setting. Designed to support your healing journey, our facility features comfortable therapy rooms, spacious group areas, and dedicated school support spaces to help teens balance their mental health and academics.
Here, you’ll find a safe, structured environment focused on healing and growth—where you or your loved one can feel supported every step of the way.
Enter through the gate at 10932 Klingerman St and drive to the end of the driveway. You’ll find Clear Behavioral Health in Unit A on your left. Parking is available in this area.

Care is only as effective as the experts providing it, and we’re not shy about telling the world that some of the best in the business are right here at Clear Behavioral Health. But don’t just take our word for it – get to know them yourselves.

mainEntity.name: How can adults access outpatient mental health treatment in El Monte?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adults can start outpatient care at our El Monte location by calling our admissions team for a free, confidential assessment. We offer in-person and virtual options, including Partial Hospitalization (PHP), Intensive Outpatient (IOP), and standard outpatient programs. Each plan is customized with individual therapy, group sessions, medication management, and holistic services to fit your needs.

mainEntity.name: What insurance plans are accepted at Clear Behavioral Health El Monte?

acceptedAnswer.text: We are in-network with most major insurance providers, including Anthem, Aetna, Magellan, Health Net, UnitedHealthcare, TRICARE, and TriWest. We also work with First Health, Meritain Health, Ambetter, MHN, Optum, and UMR. Contact us for a free benefits check.

mainEntity.name: Are El Monte outpatient mental health services LGBTQ+ affirming?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Clear Behavioral Health is committed to inclusive, culturally competent care for LGBTQIA+ individuals. Our programs provide safe, affirming spaces for teens and adults to explore their identity and receive support without judgment.

mainEntity.name: What mental health conditions are treated at the El Monte outpatient center?

acceptedAnswer.text: We provide evidence-based treatment for depression, anxiety, bipolar disorder, PTSD, OCD, ADHD, personality disorders, grief, stress and burnout, psychosis, and other behavioral health concerns. Our licensed clinicians create individualized plans to address each client’s specific needs.

mainEntity.name: Can teens attend school while in outpatient treatment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our teen outpatient programs are designed to support academic success, offering flexible daytime and evening sessions, educational assistance, and virtual therapy options so students can continue their education while receiving care.
